rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose adverb for “completely” or “entirely.”

example.english: I fully understand what you’re talking about.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jyun4 cyun4 ming4 baak6 nei5 gong2 gan2 mat1

rows.note: Use this before a quantity to stress that the amount reaches that full figure.

example.english: The bus was fully two hours late.
example.traditional: 架巴士足足遲咗兩個鐘。
example.jyutping: gaa3 baa1 si2 zuk1 zuk1 ci4 zo2 loeng5 go3 zung1
